title: Consuelo Velázquez's birth chart
metaDescription: Consuelo Velázquez's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 6.1° Virgo. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: Tightest of all, the Sun holds a trine to Jupiter at 0.7° — close enough to weld identity to expansion. A trine runs downhill — the talent that never announces itself because it never had to.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: 6.1° of Virgo is the Sun's exact seat — first decan, 0°–10°, sub-ruled by Mercury in the old triplicity scheme. The degree is the address; the sign is only the street.

blocks.title: The personal registers
blocks.text: Closer in, Mercury stands at 0.8° Libra; Venus stands at 20.9° Cancer; Mars stands at 23.4° Libra. The tradition reads thought that travels by comparison from Mercury, attraction that works by atmosphere from Venus, effort aimed through strategy and words from Mars.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: Nothing in the geometry sits closer than the Sun and Jupiter: 0.7° from an exact trine. A third of the circle is the tradition’s friendliest distance — same element, shared assumptions, no translation required. Behind it, Jupiter sextile Pluto at 1.2°, and Jupiter square Neptune at 1.7° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. Every angle named here holds for the whole of that day at the birthplace, so an unknown hour cannot take it away.

blocks.title: What the angles build
blocks.text: The Moon makes no major aspect that survives the day; the old reading gives such a planet autonomy — it acts alone, sometimes loudly.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: Read against the old dignities, two placements stand out. Mars in Libra at 23.4° is in detriment — the planet opposite its home, working against the grain; Saturn in Cancer at 26.0° is in detriment. None of this ranks anyone; dignity describes footing, and footing can be worked with.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: The certain ground: 10 placements whose signs hold for the whole day, dividing 3 earth, 3 air, 3 water, 1 fire by element and 5 cardinal, 3 fixed, 2 mutable by mode. Jupiter and Uranus were retrograde — the optical reversal the tradition reads as review — energy turned over before it is turned out.

blocks.title: The Moon, and how far it can move
blocks.text: The Moon stayed in Virgo for the whole of that day at the birthplace, covering 12.4° between midnight and midnight. The missing clock moves the Moon by half a sign at most here, and the boundary was never close. At the noon reference it stands at 18.0°.
